snippet.title: The Last Good Boy - 1.0 Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the full release on September 4th! There is a Free Demo Too.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3524950/The_Last_Good_Boy/

🎮 Join the community on Discord
👉 https://discord.gg/yQh4ZmD9Db

After almost 3 years of development, I'm finally announcing the launch date. 
It will be on September 4th (04/09/2026). I can't wait to see your feedback.


🐶 Last Good Boy 🐶 
A Cozy idle RPG inspired by my real-life dog called Ramon, the goodest boy in the world. Gather, craft, unlock new lands, enchant your gear, and battle monsters on a quest to find out where all the other good boys have gone.

#TheLastGoodBoy #IdleGame #CozyGaming #IndieDev #DogLovers #Gamedev #UnityGames #IncrementalGames #IndieGameTrailer #DogGame #CozyGames
